title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the 'renovated' column in the DataFrame. Notice that some entries have a value of 'None'. These represent rooms that have never been renovated.

title: Filtering Non-None Values
text: To filter out rows where 'renovated' is 'None', you can use the `isna()` function to identify these rows and then use the `~` operator to select the opposite.
